Registration date: PRED-1442.B2 (registered 2026-08-09) is from a text titled as the authored chain of 13–14 November 2025, and PRED-991.B4 (registered 2026-05-05) from the Autumn Notebook of October–November 2025; both registrations are deposit dates later than the composition dates their titles give.
Registration date: PRED-3.G14 is registered 2026-06-17 (the registry's first version) but its statement quotes an operator ruling of 2026-10-13.

PRED-856.F1 names the RTT protocol (Sharks 2026) as its method, which is PRED-161.G1's deposit (#161, The Reverse Turing Test); they are linked as a series, not merged, since H3 concerns AI-mediated human text generally and #856 chat inputs specifically.
